issue.title: Add supported sidecar-ref keys to the public config schema
issue.description: PROPOSED BY the sase-u6 epic plan phase resolve, which explicitly left this pre-existing gap out of phase scope. KNOWN_REF_CONFIG_KEYS accepts capabilities, relations, grouping, and xprompt in provider ref specs, but definitions.sidecarRef has additionalProperties false and omits all four properties. Add schema definitions matching the shipped contracts and tests proving valid supported specs are accepted while malformed declarations remain rejected.

task_type_fields.impact: Editor completion and Config Center schema fidelity reject or hide valid provider ref configuration even though runtime supports it.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare KNOWN_REF_CONFIG_KEYS in src/sase/_sidecar_ref_constants.py with definitions.sidecarRef.properties in src/sase/config/sase.schema.json; capabilities, relations, grouping, and xprompt are accepted by runtime code but rejected by Draft7Validator because sidecarRef sets additionalProperties false.
